name: Always Rain
summary: Sometimes rain makes minecraft feel more sad but peaceful, this mod makes it always rain so you could always have this feeling.
description: # Always Rain ![Always Rain cover image](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Sekai0NI0itamio/always-rain/main/.modcompiler-art/description-image.webp) Always Rain is a simple mod that makes it rain all the time in a Minecraft world. It also keeps thunderstorms on if you want them, and the weather setting can be changed while the game is running. ### How It Works (for the user) - The rain never stops unless you change the config. - Thunder can stay on continuously if you set the config to “thunderstorm”. - You can edit the config file while the game is running; the changes take effect immediately. - No new items, blocks, mobs, or commands are added. ### Features - Full‑time rain across the world. - Optional constant thunder when the config is set to thunderstorm. - Config file hot‑reloads without restarting the game. - Works on any Forge server that loads the mod. - No extra inventory or UI changes. ### Why Use This Mod? - Keeps your builds wet without manually using commands. - Great for adventure maps or builds that need constant rain. - Easy to toggle thunderstorms on or off via a tiny text file. - Light‑weight and does not interfere with other mods. ## What You'll Notice - Rain stays on all the time. - Thunder can stay on if the config is set to thunderstorm.
